name: Types Of Christ
overview: The study of Types of Christ reveals how God’s redemptive plan is foreshadowed throughout Scripture, as seen in figures and symbols like Abel, whose blood cried out for justice, and Noah, who brought comfort amid judgment. The provision of Melchizedek, offering bread and wine as a priest of the Most High God, points forward to Christ’s eternal priesthood. These examples, along with others such as the Ark and the tree of life, illustrate God's consistent work in preparing the way for Christ’s ultimate sacrifice and salvation.
